Module dev.metaschema.core
Package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter

Class AbstractBinaryAdapter<ITEM_TYPE extends IAnyAtomicItem>

java.lang.Object
dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeAdapter<ByteBuffer,ITEM_TYPE>
dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.AbstractBinaryAdapter<ITEM_TYPE>
Type Parameters:
ITEM_TYPE - the metapath item type supported by the adapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
IDataTypeAdapter<ByteBuffer>
Direct Known Subclasses:
Base64Adapter, HexBinaryAdapter
public abstract class AbstractBinaryAdapter<ITEM_TYPE extends IAnyAtomicItem> extends AbstractDataTypeAdapter<ByteBuffer,ITEM_TYPE>
Maintains a byte buffer representation of a byte stream.

The maintained byte stream is kept in a decoded form.
